Ollie (sales): New RFI from Meridian Tech. They want a compact capability matrix, security questionnaire answers, and three POC pricing tiers. CRM: https://crm.redwood/deals/MER-77/rfi.pdf
Sofia (solutions): I'll take the matrix + runbook. Proposed POC split: 5d bench / 7d integration / 3d acceptance.
Marcus (eng): For 70B perf note: p50 token latency ~170ms on A100-80GB at batch=8. Will add numbers to the matrix and flag quantization caveats.
Leah (security): Flags: BYOK via HSM, audit logs to SIEM, EU data residency. We support PKCS#11 + cloud HSM; default log retention 90d (extendable).
Ollie (sales): Buyer asked about support during POC (SE hours + escalation). Can we offer 4hr SLA for responses during the POC window?
Marcus (eng): Yes — provide dedicated SE hours (8am-6pm) and on-call escalation for infra incidents. For private installs, remote-only unless SOW includes onsite.
Sofia (solutions): Draft pricing tiers: hosted eval (payg), dedicated short commit (4 weeks), private eval (install + support uplift). I'll upload matrix + price sheet.
crm-bot: Files uploaded to deal folder: meridian-capability.csv, meridian-poc-pricing.xlsx, meridian-runbook.md
Leah (security): I'll upload short questionnaire answers and mark items needing legal review (data flows, SLA indemnities).
Ollie (sales): Deadline: first draft by Tuesday COB. Please react :white_check_mark: when uploaded.
Marcus (eng): :white_check_mark:
Sofia (solutions): :white_check_mark:
